text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The Senior tier starting next year... 
There are plenty of major races.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If I want to become a Rice that brings 
happiness to everyone, there are so many 
races I just can't afford to miss...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I lost sight of what I should be 
aiming for when running. Even when I went 
to the track, my legs just wouldn't 
move..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—That's when I forced myself out to the 
track and happened to see it.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Daaaaahhhh—!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like fun...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice wants to run too...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hup, hup, hup, hup!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! I'm warming up! Mornings really do 
feel amazing!

Days of steady preparation for the Diamond 
Stakes continued. Then, early one 
morning...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is that Rice-san in the distance? Is 
she doing morning practice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —Phew! Alright, one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
By the time Miss Bourbon returns, I have 
to become stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —Taaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at that sharpness! Looks like 
she's feeling much better!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I was worried when she was so down in the 
dumps, but all's well that ends well~

From that day on, Rice Shower could be 
seen giving it her all on the track every 
single day.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, phew, haa... Can't... breathe—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Still, I can keep going... can't I!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Haaah――!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice-san...
Then, one day.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, whew...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Alright, quota met! Yep, my time's looking 
pretty good too~.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Good work, Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, Bourbon-san! Can you run already?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, running at full speed is still not 
permitted. I am doing walking exercises 
instead.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, I would like to train the 
way I used to, but my doctor has strongly 
reminded me, 'Do not overdo it under any 
circumstances.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, recovery is expected to be faster 
than anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Really! What a relief~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You look so healthy, what a relief! When I 
came to visit, you were feeling a bit 
down, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That is... true, yes. I was feeling 'under 
the weather' back then.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Because we had just finished the 
Kikuka-sho and were 'full of enthusiasm' 
heading into the Senior Class."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I see, you're right...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Still, as expected of Bourbon-san! She 
has the strength to stand right back up 
without giving in!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, I consider that to be somewhat 
different from bouncing back on one's own.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...The other day, I saw Rice run.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Compared to the Rice of the past, her 
form, speed, and time had all improved by 
leaps and bounds.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, though I couldn't explain 
why, I couldn't take my eyes off her as 
she ran――

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
During our pursuit of the Classic Triple 
Crown, I found myself remembering the 
words of mutual respect we exchanged, and 
the promise we made for after we reached 
the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Watching that small back sprint up the 
uphill slope—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
""You mustn't give up here." It felt as 
though I was being told just that.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Rice-san is...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Rice-san is a wonderful Umamusume.

On the way home that day, 
Matikanetannhauser was unusually quiet.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So it was Rice-san who gave Bourbon-san 
that push, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Many, many times more than the makeshift 
"It'll be okay!" I offered in the hospital 
room—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The way Rice-san ran truly carried real 
power, didn't it?

As Machikane Tannhauser spoke, her cheeks 
seemed slightly flushed with red.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing, isn't it! I can't even 
find the right words for it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because it was Rice-san 
that she was able to encourage 
Bourbon-san.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean Rice-san is like a hero to 
Bourbon-san... or rather, um.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A presence shining brightly at the center 
of my heart, giving me courage and the 
strength to move forward—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "Protagonist."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... "Protagonist." I think that fits 
best.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...'The protagonist,' she truly is one. 
Rice-san is amazing.

Even after that, she kept murmuring the 
word "protagonist" over and over, savoring 
every syllable.
